intent_en: Compare reported pension assets and liabilities with actual liabilities and determine the unfunded gap.
narration_support: pension liabilities total $7 trillion. So $3 .6 trillion in assets minus $7 trillion in liabilities results in an unfunded total liability of $3 .4 trillion
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart comparing Reported Assets, Reported Liabilities, and Actual Liabilities, highlighting the Actual Unfunded Liability as the difference between Actual Liabilities and Reported Assets.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly calculates the unfunded liability ($3.4 trillion) using Hoover Institution figures ($7 trillion liabilities vs $3.6 trillion assets). The chart visualizes this by showing Actual Liabilities ($7.0tr) significantly exceeding Reported Liabilities ($4.8tr) and Reported Assets ($3.6tr), with the gap labeled as Actual Unfunded Liability ($3.4 trillion).
narrative_goal: To demonstrate the substantial unfunded pension liability gap by contrasting reported financial figures with actual liability estimates.
current_model_input: Compare reported pension assets and liabilities with actual liabilities and determine the unfunded gap.
